title: DiscordGui
body:
#  What is DiscordGUI?
 
Stop spamming chat with raw, ugly links! DiscordGUI is a lightweight utility plugin that transforms the standard _**/discord**_ command into a sleek, interactive inventory menu.

Powered by the **robust GUIEngine API**, this plugin ensures efficient menu handling while giving you absolute control over how your community links are presented to players. It's the perfect way to make a professional first impression.

##  Key Features
> ⚡ Simple Command: Players simply run /discord to open the menu instantly.

> 🎨 Fully Configurable: You control the GUI title, size, and layout.

> 🛠️ Deep Customization: Edit the Material, Display Name, Lore, and Slot for every single item.

> 💬 Message Control: Full support for custom chat messages and error handling.

> 🌈 Color Support: Uses standard & color codes (and Hex colors on supported versions).

> ⚡ Optimized: Built on the GUIEngine framework for maximum performance and minimal lag.

##  Dependencies
IMPORTANT: This plugin requires GUIEngine to function.

Please ensure you have GUIEngine installed on your server before running DiscordGUI, or the plugin will not load.
